title: The software supply chain compliance demo
body: A customer on a 50-seat contract has 47 repositories in their GitHub organization, and three of them are connected and scanning, so the contract covers 6% of that codebase. That gap is one of the scenarios in a revenue-operations environment for software supply chain compliance. The SQL that computes the coverage ratio and the dollar-weighted expansion estimate runs live on this site, against a real Postgres schema holding data that is seeded and fictional. Another scenario watches fixed-date compliance events, because a PCI DSS 4.0 audit and the EU Cyber Resilience Act requirement for SBOM disclosure by December 2027 each open a buying window that no system monitors. I built the environment to show that the approach applies to data outside one company.
signals: Modeled sources: Salesforce, GitHub, Crunchbase, CI/CD scan logs
